column1: # ESP32-family 4MB flash layout with LittleFS and OTA.
# The filesystem image is LittleFS because platformio.ini sets:
# Arduino LittleFS.begin() defaults to partition label "spiffs"
# filesystem partition keeps that label/subtype for runtime compatibility.
# Two OTA app slots are retained
# to 0x1C0000 by reducing the filesystem partition to 0x60000.
